title: Support skip install deps
body:
## Changes

<!-- What does this change, in plain language? Include screenshots or videos if helpful.  -->
`--run=false` does not seem to work, once we carry the `run` parameter in the command, no matter what its value is set, `arg()` will format it as `true`, consider replacing it Into `--skip-install`.

By the way, this PR also fixes #221
